jobs.company: Second Nature Ecology and Design, LLC
jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
We're seeking a part-time GIS analyst to apply spatial analysis and remote sensing to our ecological planning work.

You'll work alongside our ecologists and designers to map habitat, tree canopy, and land cover; screen sites and portfolios using desktop data; and produce maps and spatial datasets to inform goal-setting, site design, and monitoring. Projects range from single urban sites in the San Francisco Bay Area to multi-site portfolios across the US and Europe. You'll also help us organize our GIS data and build workflows that make analyses repeatable from one project to the next.

The ideal candidate is experienced in ArcGIS and remote sensing and has worked with landscape and ecological datasets such as land cover, vegetation and habitat maps, and species occurrence records.

This is a part-time, hourly position with a flexible schedule where hours will vary depending on project needs.

**Minimum qualifications**

* BS in GIS, geography, ecology, environmental science, or a related field
* Expertise in ArcGIS Pro, including spatial analysis, geoprocessing, and cartography
* Expertise in remote sensing, including classification and analysis of aerial, satellite, or lidar data
* Experience working with landscape and ecological datasets, such as land cover, vegetation and habitat maps, tree canopy, and species occurrence data
* Availability for part-time, hourly work on a flexible, project-based schedule

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Spatial analysis and remote sensing**

* Map existing land cover, habitat types, tree canopy, and impervious surfaces from aerial and satellite imagery, lidar, and land-use classification data
* Conduct desktop baseline assessments and regional context evaluations for individual sites and multi-site portfolios, including review of historical imagery
* Conduct spatial analyses to understand spatial patterns and processes and summarize spatial information.
* Compile and analyze species occurrence data from sources such as GBIF, iNaturalist, and eBird to characterize species and habitat value
* Evaluate landscape context, including habitat connectivity and proximity to sensitive habitats, waterways, and protected areas
* Quantify outcomes such as habitat area and condition, canopy cover, and heat island and carbon benefits to support biodiversity metrics and sustainability reporting

**Data management and workflows**

* Help organize, document, and maintain our GIS data library, project files, and metadata
* Help establish standard, repeatable workflows so desktop screenings and habitat analyses can be applied consistently across projects and portfolios
* Integrate field data from our ecologists, such as habitat maps, vegetation condition assessments, and survey points, with desktop datasets
* Set up and maintain field data collection tools such as ArcGIS Field Maps
* Check spatial data for accuracy and completeness before it goes into analyses and deliverables

**Products**

* Produce clear, well-designed maps and graphics for slide decks, reports, and client presentations
* Deliver GIS files and spreadsheet summaries of spatial results to clients and design teams

**Working style**

* Attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, well-documented data
* Clear written and verbal communication with teammates and clients
* Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team
* Work closely with ecologists, designers, and partner landscape architects and engineers to translate spatial findings into design and strategy recommendations

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

**GIS workflows**

* Ability to help organize GIS data and establish standardized, well-documented workflows for a small team
* Experience automating repeatable analyses with Python (ArcPy) or ModelBuilder
* Familiarity with ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Field Maps

**Technical**

* Experience with Google Earth Engine and R for spatial analysis
* Familiarity with biodiversity assessment frameworks, such as habitat condition scoring or biodiversity net gain metrics

\*\*\*\*

Second Nature Ecology + Design provides innovative biodiversity services to create ecological and social impact. Collaborating with leading corporations, creative firms, and high-impact NGOs, we apply state-of-the-art science and tailored support to bring the essential benefits of nature to diverse settings. Drawing on our team of ecologists and designers, we develop award-winning nature strategies that catalyze biodiversity, climate resilience, and human well-being. Our distributed team has locations across the US and Europe, with our core location in the SF Bay Area.

**Website:** www.secondnatureeco.com

**To apply**

Please include a cover letter and resume indicating your interest and qualifications for this position. Applications will be reviewed beginning November 16.
